Universal most plausibly runs a value-added/sequencing line INSIDE a GM-controlled building (GM converted Powertrain space into an on-site Logistics Operations Center) or a leased warehouse not publicly documented. coords here point at the GM Spring Hill plant complex as a best-available area anchor only - NOT a confirmed Universal building.
